title: TrueNorth game configuration
description: The single source of truth for base path, locales, design resolution, unlock rules, exam rules, scheduler tuning, graphics presets, performance budgets and feature flags.

version.description: Semantic version of the configuration payload.

basePath.description: Vite base and router prefix. Must start and end with a slash (ADR-0006).

levels.description: Level ids in authoring order. Empty until slice 1.

locomotionModes.description: Every way a level may declare that the player moves. THE LEGAL SET, as data (ADR-0023). A mode carries no behaviour: there is one `step` and every mode goes through it, differing only by the `LocomotionTuning` a level document supplies - so a new mode is a name here plus a tuning there plus a `labelKey` in the locale bundles, and no code at all. It was an eight-value enum in level.schema.json until Quebec City wanted a toboggan and slice 2, whose whole purpose is proving a level is addable by JSON and assets alone, would have had to begin by editing a schema and a port. A name here is what a level document's `locomotion[].mode` is checked against, so a typo is still a build failure and not a load-time surprise.

initialLevels.description: Levels playable before any stamp is earned.

order.description: Progression order used when a level is unlocked by the previous one.

exam.title: Exam rules
exam.description: Mirrors IRCC: 20 questions, 15 to pass, 30 minutes, timer optional.

scheduler.title: Scheduler tuning
scheduler.description: Tuning for the FSRS-backed review scheduler in the domain layer.

exclusionWindow.description: Number of recent questions that may not repeat.

wrongWeight.description: Relative draw weight of a previously wrong question.

dailyNewLimit.description: Maximum unseen questions introduced per day.

study.title: Study rules
study.description: Study mode, the drill a player runs outside a quest.

drillSize.description: How many questions one Study drill asks. The number lives here rather than in a scene so the copy that says "3 of 5" and the loop that stops at five read the same value.

save.title: Save rules
save.description: Limits on the save file, held in config rather than in code because SECURITY.md's cap and the message that reports it must not drift apart.

maxImportBytes.description: Largest file JSON import will read, in bytes. SECURITY.md requires a cap; a save that exceeds it is refused before it is parsed, with save.import.tooBig. 1 MB is roughly two orders of magnitude above a full ten-level save.

budgets.title: Performance budgets
budgets.description: CI gates. Breaching any of these fails the build.

theme.title: Colour theme
theme.description: The palette a scene paints itself from: a vertical sky-to-ground gradient, the horizon rule across it, and the two text colours that must stay readable on both ends of that gradient (ADR-0002). The same shape is reused per level, so a level document can override the whole block without an engine change; when it is absent the renderer keeps its built-in default.

sky.description: Top of the vertical gradient. Also the renderer clear colour and the page background behind the letterboxed canvas.

horizon.description: The horizon rule at two-thirds height. Must read as a bright line against the gradient behind it.

ink.description: Primary on-canvas text. Needs at least 4.5:1 against every stop of the gradient.

inkMuted.description: Secondary on-canvas text. Same contrast floor as ink.
